shadows.name: metric-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on selectable metric and risk cards.

motion.name: metric-hover
motion.value: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease
motion.purpose: The existing hover transition; source currently has no reduced-motion override.

components.name: Text action
components.css: .ds-action { padding: 0; border: 0; color: #1260e9; background: transparent; font: 700 .75rem Manrope, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #76a7ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter select
components.description: Native dimension select; disabled variants stay visibly unavailable.
components.css: .ds-filter { height: 36px; min-width: 112px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #dce5f4; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-filter select { width: 100%; border: 0; color: #16315f; background: transparent; font: 650 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-filter select:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: #91a1bb; } .ds-filter select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #76a7ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metric card
components.description: Whole-card action; this style preview deliberately contains no business values.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-height: 144px; width: 100%; padding: 18px 17px 14px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #dee7f5; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #10224c; font: 750 .82rem Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; } .ds-metric:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 13px 28px rgb(32 71 145 / 11%); border-color: #b9cef9; } .ds-metric:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #76a7ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Priority badge
components.description: High priority uses a warm tint and explicit text.
components.css: .ds-priority { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 20px; font: 750 .7rem Manrope, sans-serif; color: #c73035; background: #ffdedf; }

components.name: Data panel
components.description: Shared container for performance, decision queue, and funnel sections.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dce6f4; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgb(27 63 128 / 5%); color: #10224c; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-panel header { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2eaf7; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.02rem; letter-spacing: -.025em; }

narrative.overview: The supplied PSM Morning Review mockup is the binding visual reference: a clean, compact leadership dashboard with white panels, deep navy text, blue interactions, and restrained risk colors. There is no sidebar. This standalone app has its own Manrope-based visual system; do not import the typography, shell, or tokens of another MAGPPIE project.
dos: Do preserve the supplied reference's six-KPI, five-risk, paired-table, and funnel composition at desktop size.
Do keep the standalone app's Manrope typography, white surfaces, and navy/blue hierarchy.
Do retain labels alongside risk color, accessible control names, and visible focus.
Do preserve demo disclosures and current filter/drilldown limitations.
donts: Don't add a sidebar, decorative hero, or an unrelated dashboard shell.
Don't fabricate CRM values, trend directions, conversion rates, or functioning lead details in documentation or styling.
Don't treat this source extraction as a browser, accessibility, or live-data validation report.
